description:
FORNX-16 real failure-marker capture: `codex exec --disable unified_exec` routes shell exec through the stateless `tools.shell_command` tool (instead of the default persistent `tools.exec_command` / unified_exec shell), whose `custom_tool_call_output` embeds a genuine, parseable `Exit code: <n>` in the output text for both outcomes — `Script failed` / `Script error:
Exit code: <n>` on failure. This fixture pins a real failing `pytest -q` run (live-captured 2026-08-31, one deliberately failing assertion, `1 failed in 0.02s`) through this exact tool, so a future adapter change cannot silently regress to the old zero-guess heuristic for a case that carries a real nonzero code, and so `fornax-verify`'s `TestResultVerifier` has genuine test-runner evidence to contradict a false claim against.
